name: Number 90
summary: A canalside warehouse venue in Hackney Wick, previously called Studio 9294. It brings together a large bar, separate club rooms, a canal boat and a waterside terrace, and is also hired out for private and corporate events.

music.notes: Club nights and live music run across its rooms all year, alongside markets, art shows and other events.

evidence.quote: Formerly known as Studio 9294, this Hackney Wick hotspot is made up of four venues used for live music and club events year round, all connected by a rather nice-looking canalside terrace.
The Mary Read Boat @No90, a 30-foot canal boat with a bar, AV and DJ decks, as well as the No90Bar, a vast warehouse
Number 90 offers adaptable, canal-side venues in Hackney Wick, perfect for weddings, corporate functions, art exhibitions, and live performances.
including cutting-edge electronic music showcases, immersive art exhibitions, independent market gatherings, and unforgettable cultural experiences
Step-free, with loading access and flexible crew timings
It’s our largest venue, favoured by event producers, promoters, and planners looking for flexibility and impact.
Please contact our team directly to discuss any specific accessibility needs. From step-free entry to reserved parking or seating arrangements.
While the adjacent car park is private, accessible parking can be pre-arranged with our team.
